Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:
> Joseph DiGiaccomo [KoT:V]
> Cardtype: Vampire
> Clan: Ventrue
> Group: 5
> Capacity: 6
> Discipline: aus dom for PRE
> Camarilla: Joseph untaps whenever any Methuselah puts a master: location in play.
>
Does Jospeh untap when a Master: location (in the narrow sense) is put into play, or does his special ability also includes Master: unique locations?

I guess the former, but I want to make sure.

Messages.Author: Squidalot
Messages.Body:
Unique locations are a subset of locations.

I assume you're waiting for Pascal to answer this - but you can see how 'location' applies equally with Arika or Therbold Realty to 'Unique' and non-unique locations.

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:
I agree on the subset relation between general locations and unique locations. But both Arika and Therbold Realty use only the word "locations", while Joseph explicitly uses the term "Master: location".

So let's wait what the official rules monger has to say about this ..

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> extrala wrote:
> I agree on the subset relation between general locations and unique locations. But both Arika and Therbold Realty use only the word "locations", while Joseph explicitly uses the term "Master: location".
>
> So let's wait what the official rules monger has to say about this ..
>
Because Arika affects Palatial Estate, whereas Joseph ignores it.
Anyway, a Master: unique location is a location + a master + a unique card, so if it's a least a Master + location, Joseph is happy and untaps.
Think also of Path of Typhoon that reduce the cost of cards that require Serpentis and that work on Typhonic Beast that require Serpentis + Potence.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Squidalot wrote:
> Unique locations are a subset of locations.
>
Correct - which means the answer to the initial question is "Yes, Joseph untaps when Secure Haven (or other similar Master: unique location) are put in play".

For some reason, non-master unique locations have beene reworded to "location. unique." but no the master cards. I'll see to have this checked for the next RTR.

Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body: Might I submit a request that non-master locations be addressed in RTR by the loving community sobriquet of 'locquipment'? It'd be a truly groundbreaking CCG keyword.

Messages.Body:
